premises.statement: The rows table is the memory image at the rows buffer: for every p < n and i < n, rows p i as an integer is mu (fr + n + p*n + i). This is the class (ii) cache boundary, not instance arithmetic: both direct routes were measured refuted (the copy pass costs 13n^2+6n against n+12 slack, and setting rb := x.a contradicts MatInst.Pre.belowA). The producer is the cache call; CacheFill.cacheReads_of_solves and CacheFill.reads_persist are landed, the call itself is not wired.
The oracle's return: the delivery is the bracket fold seeded at row t's head. Supplied by the oracle functional chain of the composite-incidence construction; not derivable from instance arithmetic.
The tight clock: Tt 0 <= callerTt x.n. The producer is the re-clocked selection round's solvedIn; it is not derivable from taskTime (instanceSize ...), which is about 100n^4 against 25n^2.
MinPlusIdentity: the head's delivery is every entry, so the bracket accumulation is (min,+)-product entrywise. The construction identity of the upstream boundary.
